baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked construction يَعْلَمُ ... بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ... خَلْفَهُمْ, followed by the passive تُرْجَعُ, encloses the subjects and their affairs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure, the interval between parties, the region in front, and the region behind compose a two-sided field with no unobserved edge; the return of every affair gives that field a single destination as well as a single knower.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic exposure governing the whole construction.
The middle or interval between sides supplies the central spatial relation of the field.
What is between the hands supplies the near or forward-facing side of the field.
What is behind supplies the opposed rear side, completing the enclosure.
Return or restoration supplies the convergent movement of the dispersed field back to one source.
Affair as state or case makes the convergence comprehensive rather than limited to persons.

changed_reading.before: A general assertion that God knows their past and future and that everything returns to Him.
changed_reading.after: Each subject is positioned inside a front-middle-rear field wholly exposed to divine knowledge, while every case within that field converges on God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَيْدِيهِمْ can evoke what hands enact, خَلْفَهُمْ what action leaves after itself, and ٱلْأُمُورُ the resulting cases that are returned.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hand converts a merely temporal front into enacted agency; what comes after or stands in another's place becomes the residue and succession of action; return gathers those outward consequences back as accountable cases.

activation_trace.role: Deeds attributed to the hands turn the forward field into an arena of performed action.
What comes after and occupies another's place supplies consequences and successors left behind.
Return supplies the retrieval of effects that had moved outward from their agents.
Affairs as cases give the retrieved deeds and consequences an adjudicable form.

changed_reading.before: Before and behind are only chronological coverage.
changed_reading.after: The verse also knows action at the hands, its downstream residue, and the eventual referral of both agent and consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The force-bearing hand, affairs as authority, and their passive return to Allah permit an administrative reading of the closing clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hand can carry delegated force and an affair can be a domain of rule; because the affairs are returned rather than remaining with those hands, delegated agency is bounded by report-back to the originating authority.

activation_trace.role: The hand as effective authority supplies a possible delegated agent.
Affair as office or jurisdiction supplies the domain temporarily exercised.
Return to an originating direction prevents delegated jurisdiction from becoming autonomous.
The worshipped one is the explicit terminus to whom every delegated affair returns.

changed_reading.before: Return names only a final cosmic destination.
changed_reading.after: Return also sounds like the closure of delegated authority: agents act within a known field, but every jurisdiction reports back to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier accusation that a person's hands have put something forward supplies an enacted record; the stated outcome of affairs and the later judgment over disagreement convert the focus verse's front, rear, and return into a deed-to-consequence-to-verdict flow.

activation_trace.role: Advancing something forward supplies the directional act that precedes the hand's later accounting.
The deed attributed to the hands makes the focus hand-image morally operative, not merely locative.
The end or outcome of a thing supplies the downstream consequence toward which deeds move.
Commanded conduct and the affairs whose outcome belongs to God join action to its resulting case.
Judgment between people supplies the terminal legal operation performed on returned cases.
Parties taking divergent paths supplies the unresolved difference brought back for judgment.
The focus return is the arrow that carries deed, residue, and dispute into final jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 22:10 uses the same hand image with explicit forward action.
22:41 closely couples Allah, the outcome, and affairs.
22:68-69 moves from human disputation to divine judgment between the disputants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forwarded hand-deeds, the outcome of affairs, disagreement, and divine judgment; I infer a ledger-to-verdict arrow connecting them. A live alternative is that each occurrence independently illustrates general omniscience without forming one legal process.

changed_reading.before: God knows every temporal side of people and all things return to Him.
changed_reading.after: God knows deeds already put forward, the divergent consequences left behind, and the complete case that returns for judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first depicts a messenger transmission exposed to alien casting, then removal and confirmation, later locates exhaustive knowledge in a written record, and immediately before the focus selects angelic and human messengers. The focus knowledge can therefore guard both the upstream and downstream sides of a vulnerable message chain, with all disputed transmissions returned for correction and settlement.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the transmission channel whose two sides become relevant in the focus.
Casting something into the channel supplies the packet's explicit disturbance to transmission.
Removal followed by replacement supplies a correction operation rather than passive observation.
Making firm and exact supplies stabilization after the intrusive casting is removed.
The written record supplies a stable reference against which the channel can be known and settled.
Selection of a purified choice supplies the commissioning act immediately before the focus.
The selected messengers supply a locally available antecedent for the focus pronoun.
Focus knowledge exposes every stage around the selected carriers.
The forward side supplies what reaches or awaits the messenger in transmission.
The rear side supplies the source-side history or aftermath not visible to a carrier.

structural_cues: 22:70 pairs divine knowledge with a book.
22:75 places selected messengers immediately before the focus pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrected transmission sequence, a written record, and selected messengers; I infer that knowing what is before and behind secures the whole relay and that return closes its disputes. The materially live alternative is that the pronoun remains universal and the messenger adjacency only exemplifies, rather than narrows, its scope.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun refers generically to people or creatures under timeless omniscience.
changed_reading.after: Without excluding the generic reading, the pronoun can locally pick up selected messengers: God knows the source-side, carrier, reception-side, and every attempted disturbance of their transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night enters day and day enters night, rain becomes green earth, the sky is held from falling by command, and life passes through death into life. These supplied alternations make front and behind readable as neighboring phases within managed processes, while return can name recurrence as well as a once-for-all endpoint.

activation_trace.role: One phase entering inside its opposite supplies a reversible boundary rather than a static before-after split.
Water supplies the material carrier that changes the state of the earth.
Fresh green growth supplies the visible phase produced after water enters the system.
Command supplies active governance of the physical processes rather than an abstract topic called affairs.
Holding and restraining supplies the stabilizing control that keeps the process ordered.
Living animation appears on both sides of death and supplies the repeated state.
Causing life-force to depart supplies the intervening reversal between the two life phases.
An interval occurring during a state or act lets the focus middle function temporally.
Alternating succession supplies one phase arriving after another.
Return supplies the general recurrence linking the successive phases back to their source.

structural_cues: 22:61 repeats the ingress verb with night and day in reversed order.
22:63 and 22:65 place material transformation and controlled motion before 22:66's life-death-life sequence.
The repeated ثم in 22:66 explicitly stages successive reversals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible ingress, material renewal, restraint by command, and life-death-life; I infer that these are instances of affairs moving through known phases and returning under one governance. A live alternative is that the focus return is exclusively eschatological and the natural cycles only demonstrate power.

changed_reading.before: Return points only from the present world toward a final endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Return still permits that endpoint, but also gathers the recurring phase changes already operating before and behind creatures under divine command.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selection creates messengers; the closing ayah distributes witness from messenger to community and from community to humanity, then commands attachment to God. The focus between them bounds this relay: witnesses occupy delegated positions before and behind one another, but knowledge and the return of jurisdiction remain divine.

activation_trace.role: Choosing a select representative supplies the first delegation in the relay.
Messenger and message supply an office positioned between sender and recipients.
The messenger at the next endpoint supplies continuity of the same representative office.
Testimony expressed from knowledge supplies the relay's accountable report across its levels.
A binding support to which one holds supplies the relay's explicit attachment back to God.
The hand as authority supplies delegated capacity within each witness position.
Affair as jurisdiction supplies what passes through, but does not terminate in, delegated offices.
Return routes every delegated report and jurisdiction back to the divine source.

structural_cues: 22:75 selects messengers immediately before the focus.
22:78 repeats messenger language and explicitly nests messenger, community, and humanity as witnesses.
The focus's return clause sits between commissioning and the command to hold fast to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selected messengers, nested witnesses, and binding attachment to God; I infer a delegated witness relay whose reports return to their source. The live alternative is that these are separate exhortations and that the focus front-rear phrase carries no institutional topology.

changed_reading.before: All affairs return directly, with no attention to intermediate human offices.
changed_reading.after: The verse can acknowledge a layered messenger-witness network while denying it independent ownership: every delegated office remains surrounded by divine knowledge and returns its affairs to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates mark, explanatory sign, repeated inscription, and appointment branches rather than the nearest senses of knowing and returning. It remains anchored in four focus roots and is sharpened by the packet's written-book cue; downstream prose should present it only as a record-making analogy, not as a lexical replacement for the surface syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins knowing, an interval around subjects, return, and affairs; packet branches let each be imagined as a trace-bearing record operation.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides to its object turns knowledge into legibility.
Disclosure through speech, writing, or sign supplies the means by which the interval becomes readable.
Repeated lines of inscription make return imaginable as retracing and reinforcement.
A marker or appointed time lets each affair carry a resolvable sign.
The explicit written book gives the record analogy a context-supplied material form.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge observes an already complete inventory of affairs.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, affairs leave signs before and behind their agents, and their return is also their re-inscription into a fully legible record.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the gathered-water branch of ع ل م and the returning-water branch of ر ج ع are form-distant from the surface predications. The reading remains anchored by those focus inventories, the focus branch of renewed growth after loss, and the packet's rain-to-green sequence; downstream prose should keep it as a material analogy for governed return, never as the primary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots can coactivate gathered water, returning rain, and renewed growth after disappearance around the explicit return of affairs.

activation_trace.role: Much gathered water supplies the reservoir image at the source of the analogy.
Growth or provision returning after prior loss supplies regenerative succession behind the present state.
Returning rain or water supplies a literal material circuit for the focus return.
Packet-supplied water grounds the otherwise remote focus branches in an explicit material event.
Fresh vegetation supplies the visible regenerated state produced by the returning water.

changed_reading.before: All affairs return along an abstract theological vector.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, return resembles water gathered, released, and made visible again as growth: affairs circulate without escaping their source.

strongest_changes: 22:10, 22:41, and 22:69 turn front, hands, aftermath, and return into a deed-to-verdict process.
22:52, 22:70, and 22:75 make protected messenger transmission a live local reading without eliminating the universal pronoun reading.
22:61-66 make managed recurrence coexist with final return.
22:75 and 22:78 expose a delegated witness relay whose authority and reports return to God.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse behaved less like a flat omniscience formula than a hinge: its front-rear topology could simultaneously organize accountability, message integrity, natural recurrence, and delegated witnessing, while remote focus branches preserved record-like and hydrologic analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate messenger antecedent for the plural pronoun is live but does not exclude a wider human or creaturely referent.
The deed-residue reading depends on carrying the hand construction of 22:10 into the focus rather than treating the focus idiom as purely locative.
The record and hydrologic outliers rely on deliberately distant branch activations and should remain qualified analogies.
